mapper.insert: INSERT INTO item (item_name, category_id, location, intent, occur_date, unique_mark, description, image_url, user_id, poster_whatsapp, publish_time) VALUES (#{itemName}, #{categoryId}, #{location}, #{intent}, #{occurDate}, #{uniqueMark}, #{description}, #{imageUrl}, #{userId}, #{posterWhatsapp}, #{publishTime})
mapper.select: SELECT item_id, item_name, category_id, location, intent, occur_date, unique_mark, description, image_url, publish_time, user_id, status FROM item WHERE status = #{status}

SELECT i.item_id AS itemId, i.item_name AS itemName, i.category_id AS categoryId, i.location, i.intent, i.status, i.occur_date AS occurDate, i.unique_mark AS uniqueMark, i.description, i.image_url AS imageUrl, i.poster_whatsapp AS posterWhatsapp, i.publish_time AS publishTime FROM item i LEFT JOIN user u ON i.user_id = u.user_id WHERE u.user_id = #{userId} AND i.status != 'deleted' ORDER BY i.publish_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE item SET status = 'deleted' WHERE item_id = #{itemId}
